definitions.explanation: So clear that anyone can see it at a glance. Used above all for differences, gaps and facts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歴然|れきぜん}として⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The gap in ability between the two was obvious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歴然|れきぜん}だ。
examples.english: The evidence is plain to see.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}した→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧としなかった⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{歴然|れきぜん}とした⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: There was a clear difference in results between those who practised and those who didn't.

notes:
A written and news-style word, most often in {歴然|れきぜん}とした⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (a clear gap).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {歴然|れきぜん}とした + noun: clear, unmistakable (⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧, ⟦{違|ちが}い→違う：01957_chigau⟧, ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧)
- {歴然|れきぜん}たる + noun: the same, more literary
- ～⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歴然|れきぜん}だ / {歴然|れきぜん}として⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: ~ is obvious

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧: clear, obvious — the everyday word; {歴然|れきぜん} stresses that the difference can be seen at a glance
